revision.title: NIOS Senior Secondary through open schooling
revision.summary: Study towards Senior Secondary through NIOS if you meet its current admission requirements.
revision.description: NIOS describes its Senior Secondary programme for learners who have passed Class X or an equivalent examination from a recognised board. Confirm current admission and subject options directly with NIOS.

steps: Check NIOS Senior Secondary admission requirements
Choose from the currently available subjects
Complete the required study and assessments

progression.title: Confirm the entry qualification
progression.description: NIOS identifies a passed Class X or equivalent examination from a recognised board as the entry relationship for Senior Secondary. Check the current admission rules before applying.

progression.title: Select available subjects
progression.description: Use the current NIOS subject scheme to confirm which subjects are offered and the requirements that apply to your programme.

progression.title: Meet the completion requirements
progression.description: NIOS states that learners must successfully complete at least five subjects for Senior Secondary certification. Confirm current assessment and completion rules with NIOS.

qualification.title: NIOS Senior Secondary certification
qualification.description: NIOS describes the qualification as equivalent to Senior Secondary/Class XII. Certification depends on meeting the current programme requirements, including successful completion of at least five subjects.

considerations.title: Entry depends on recognised prior study
considerations.description: NIOS specifies a passed Class X or equivalent examination from a recognised board. Check the current admission notice for the exact rules.

considerations.title: Subject availability is programme-specific
considerations.description: Choose from the subjects and scheme currently offered by NIOS; do not assume every subject combination is available.

sources.sourceName: NIOS Senior Secondary course and admission information
sources.termsNotes: Official NIOS information. Do not use this source to assert current fees, seat availability, or application dates without a fresh check.
sources.expectedUpdateBehavior: Recheck against current NIOS admission and course information before review or publication.
